description: Application Restrictions, Limits, and Eligibility - APPENDIX 1

features.name: Eligibility Criteria
details: Eligible segments: Regular, Upper Regular, Select, Private

features.name: Login limitation - Username policy
details: Username can be: Numbers only, Alphabets only, Alphanumeric, a combo of alphanumeric and special characters
Minimum of 7 characters and maximum of 20 characters
No spaces allowed
Username must be unique
English characters only

features.name: Login limitation - Password policy
details: Must not match the username
Must be case sensitive
Must be eight characters minimum length
Must contain at least one number, one special character, one capital letter, and one small letter , Allowed special characters:  ~ ! @ # $ % ^ & *_ - + = ` | ( ) { } [ ] : ; " ' < > , . ? / \
Must not contain a space
Cannot be any of the previous six passwords
Cannot contain Arabic characters

features.name: Application limits - Transfer
details: Maximum transaction limit for Regular customer: JOD 25,000 or equivalent
Maximum transaction limit for Select customer: JOD 50,000 or equivalent

features.name: Features limits - Cardless Withdrawal
details: Minimum amount: JOD 10
Maximum amount: JOD 1,000

features.name: Features limits - Loyalty
details: No minimum Current_Fees_Branch s
